verdict.rationale: Alma's founder O-1A page states that its flat-rate pricing has "no separate billing for RFE responses," so RFE response work is part of the engagement and not limited to the first filing. The same guide also covers RFE risk directly, describing how entity structuring prevents RFEs that challenge ownership control. Missing for 10: any mention of NOID handling, documentation of how RFE responses are run (scope, timeline, attorney involvement), and independent or hands-on corroboration of RFE outcomes.
